subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 21, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - August 21, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS community,

We're excited to share the latest developments and updates from the AcreetionOS project. As we continue to work towards our goal of creating a user-friendly and privacy-focused Linux distribution, we're making steady progress.

In the past week, we've seen several notable releases and updates in the Linux community. KDE Gear 26.08 has been released, bringing new features and improvements to the KDE ecosystem. Additionally, the Rust blog reported on a supply chain attack on the arrayref crate, highlighting the importance of security in our development process. Finally, RPM 6.1.0 has been released, offering enhanced functionality and stability.

On the AcreetionOS front, we've been busy with various commits and updates. Our GitHub repository has seen several new commits, including the addition of a Gradle publish workflow for GitHub Packages and updates to our launcher README with build badges and feature overview. We've also made progress on our Xlibre build, adding the necessary dependencies and resolving conflicts.

One of the key areas of focus for us is our Proxmox Image. We've made an initial commit to this project, laying the groundwork for future development. This will enable us to provide a more comprehensive and user-friendly experience for our users.

As we move forward, we're committed to transparency and open communication. We're working to improve our documentation and guides, including our newsletter and wiki. You can expect to see more updates and resources in the coming weeks.

We're grateful for the support and contributions from our community. Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable to us, and we're always looking for ways to improve and grow. If you have any questions or would like to get involved, please don't hesitate to reach out.

In the meantime, we're excited to share some upcoming events and milestones. We'll be participating in the upcoming Linux conference, where we'll be showcasing our latest developments and sharing our vision for the future of Linux. Stay tuned for more information on this and other events.

As always, we're committed to providing a secure and reliable experience for our users. We're working hard to ensure that AcreetionOS remains a leader in the Linux community, with a focus on user-friendliness, privacy, and security.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're excited to share this journey with you and look forward to the many exciting developments ahead.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
